sentences.text: 22.05.2023 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.

1. This is a petition filed by the petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C. seeking regular bail in case FIR No. 228/22017 under Sections 376(2)(i)/363/366 IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act registered at Police Station Karol Bagh, Delhi.
2. Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State appears on advance notice and accepts notice.
3. It is submitted by the counsel appearing for the petitioner that petitioner is in judicial custody since 20.09.2017.
He further submitted that This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 20:39:20 out of 27 witnesses only 11 witnesses have been examined till date, and all the public witnesses have been examined.
He further submitted that all the remaining witnesses are police and there are no chances of tampering with the prosecution evidence.
He seeks time to file the testimonies of the public witnesses.

4. Let the same be filed within three weeks with advance copy to the other side.
5.
Learned APP also seeks time to file the status report.
